posts.author: JasonFtheCaptain
posts.title: Some Ideas
posts.html:
These are a few Ideas I came up with to help out with some of the problems I have had that I think every one might enjoy.

Cops w/Guns:When playing as a cop you don't get gun unless if your the police commissioner. I never see any one play as the Quartermaster. The golck 17 you get as the commissioner has a ton of recoil and I believe the class should get something like an Degale and regular cops get 5-7 cause rebels always have AK47s and Shotguns. And with giving free guns to cops it helps them stand a chance.

Food:I know this has been brought up a lot but 2 food items is gets kind of boring after a while. And the Hunger timer is very annoying I would get hungry like every 1-2 minutes. I think we should only get hungry every 10-15 minutes but make food more expensive.

Class count: The rebels can have like 64 people which is the max people aloud to be on the server. Including the commissioner there can only be 11 cops total. Compared to heavily armed rebels (the most rebels I have seen was 27). I believe the cop max should increase to some thing like 15 or 20 and the rebel max decrease to 25 or 20

Mayor timer: I have played as the mayor 2 times but I didn't see a timer (so can you be mayor forever?). There are always people hogging the mayor slot and making the stupidest of laws. Like no driving or no eating WTF (saw that happen once, or that have could ave been a Dream IDK)

Alarms: I always see cars getting stolen I believe cars should have alarms that go off when lock picks are used on cars.

contraband: I don't use contraband a lot but when I do I find it annoying to reload it. I don think you should have to reload it.

This goes for everyone else too. You do not decide what ideas get implemented, I do. Therefore, you do not flame ideas and tell people that what they want will never happen, because what do you know, as things change - they might.
For instance, cops are getting guns in the future. They'll have to pay (a fairly low sum) for them and will automatically be punished if they use them improperly, but they will be getting quick'n'easy guns to help fight off the hordes.
However, if ideas are obviously impractical or I have outright said "no" to before, you can nicely explain what's wrong with the idea or suggest improvements.
But, let me make it quite absolutely clear, creativity should NOT be squashed.
Be told.
